## Skins™ Pro Series Fury-X Blaster

Take your dart blasting to the NEXT LEVEL with the XSHOT SKINS Pro Series Fury-X Blaster. Including a quick release 20 half dart capacity clip and 40 XSHOT Air Pocket Technology half darts for a further, faster and more stable flight. Featuring Slam Fire Action to blast through the 20 dart clip in seconds and take out targets up to 43m / 140 feet away! Go NEXT LEVEL with XSHOT Pro Series.
